title: `let r = a.op()` over an `or Error` result, matched in a workflow body
note: `TryPay`'s error arm saves a `Note`, so the error path COMMITS — the shape that needs the EF Core / JPA error arm to detach the account; the unchanged read-back after it is the behavioural witness.  `PayWithReceipt`'s success arm reads the op's `int` result, which elixir answers on the tagged wire and the arm unwraps.
